description: Implement domain models (User, APIResource, Subscription, ProcessedEvent), migrations, transport/application/domain/infrastructure layers, transactions, stable correlation-aware errors, rate limiting, JSON logs, /health endpoint, OpenAPI, Dockerfile, and local/container startup (subtasks 3.2, 3.3, 3.4 combined)
steps: Create Django apps structure: config/ (project settings), apps/core/ (health, middleware, error handling), apps/resources/ (APIResource CRUD), apps/billing/ (Subscription, ProcessedEvent, Stripe webhook), apps/accounts/ (User, allauth token auth)
Implement correlation ID middleware that generates/reads X-Correlation-ID header and attaches to request, logs, and error responses
Implement stable error response shape middleware: { code: str, message: str, correlationId: str, details?: list } for all error responses including DRF validation errors
Implement rate limiting using django-ratelimit with configurable thresholds via environment variables (RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS, RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW) - default 100/minute
Configure structlog for structured JSON logging with correlation ID in every log entry
Create User model extending Django's AbstractUser with allauth integration
Create APIResource model (id UUID, owner FK to User, name, description, data JSONField, created_at, updated_at) with migrations

Create Subscription model (id UUID, user FK, stripe_subscription_id, stripe_customer_id, status choices [active/canceled/past_due/incomplete], current_period_start, current_period_end, created_at, updated_at) with migrations
Create ProcessedEvent model (id UUID, provider_event_id unique, event_type, payload JSONField, processed_at, created_at) for idempotent webhook processing
Implement allauth token authentication: configure dj-rest-auth or allauth headless token endpoints for login/logout/register, token-based auth for API endpoints
Implement authorization: only resource owners can CRUD their APIResource instances, require authenticated user for all protected endpoints

Implement APIResource CRUD viewset: list (paginated, filtered by owner), create, retrieve, update (partial), delete - all within transactions, returning 401 for unauthenticated, 403 for non-owner, 404 for missing

Implement Stripe webhook endpoint: verify raw body signature using stripe.Webhook.construct_event, check ProcessedEvent for idempotency, update Subscription state based on event type (customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted)
Implement subscription status endpoint: authenticated user can view their subscription state
Implement fake/test Stripe provider mode: when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY starts with 'sk_test_fake' or STRIPE_FAKE_MODE=true, use a local fake that accepts any signature
Implement secret redaction: never expose STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, SECRET_KEY, DATABASE_URL in error responses or logs
Configure drf-spectacular for OpenAPI schema generation for all public endpoints with proper auth requirements, request/response schemas, and error schemas documented
Implement /health endpoint returning 200 {status: 'healthy', timestamp: ISO8601} - no auth required
Create Dockerfile: multi-stage build with Python 3.12 slim base, install uv, copy project, uv sync --frozen, collect static, run with gunicorn binding 0.0.0.0:8000
Create .dockerignore excluding .venv, __pycache__, .git, .env, tests/, *.pyc
Add startup documentation: local via `uv run python manage.py runserver`, container via `docker build -t django-api-backend . && docker run -p 8000:8000 --env-file .env django-api-backend`
Implement pre-commit rollback: if domain processing fails before commit, ensure no partial state is persisted (use Django's atomic transactions)
Configure Django settings for PostgreSQL (via DATABASE_URL env) with SQLite fallback for testing
Create .env.example with all required environment variables with placeholder values
Create README.md documenting all endpoints, auth setup, schema initialization, rate limiting, observability, container/local startup, deployment config
Configure pyproject.toml tool sections for ruff (line-length=99, target python 3.12), mypy (strict, django plugin), pytest (django settings module)
acceptance_criteria: All Django models (User, APIResource, Subscription, ProcessedEvent) have proper migrations that apply cleanly
APIResource CRUD endpoints work with proper auth (401/403/404 responses)
Stripe webhook endpoint verifies signatures and processes events idempotently
Rate limiting returns 429 with stable error shape when exceeded
OpenAPI schema is generated via drf-spectacular and documents all endpoints
Correlation ID appears in all error responses and structured logs
All errors use stable { code, message, correlationId, details? } shape
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/starter-kits/django-api-backend && uv sync && uv run python manage.py check
cd /projects/sandbox/starter-kits/django-api-backend && uv run python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
cd /projects/sandbox/starter-kits/django-api-backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
